## 🎯 Lead Qualifier – hot / warm / cold
Your website form or ad POSTs a new lead → Claude qualifies it (hot = ready to buy) → every lead saved to Google Sheets → hot leads ping you on WhatsApp so you can call them first.

**Setup (10 min)**
1. **Webhook**: send `{ name, phone, email, source, message }` from your form / Zapier / Meta Lead Ads to the Production URL.
2. **Claude Qualify**: add your Anthropic API key credential.
3. **Save to Sheet**: tab `Leads` with columns Timestamp, Name, Phone, Email, Source, Message, Status, Reason. Paste the sheet ID.
4. **WhatsApp Owner Alert**: WhatsApp Business Cloud API credential, your Phone Number ID, and YOUR number as recipient.
5. Activate.

---
Part of **MAP – 12 AI agents** (Kaamchor AI).
